name: Pradhan Mantri Kaushal Vikas Yojana - Short Term Training
nodalDept: Ministry Of Skill Development And Entrepreneurship
briefDescription: PMKVY Short-Term Training gives unemployed youth and school/college dropouts (15–45) free, industry-relevant skill training and a government-recognised certificate at PMKVY Training Centres.
descriptionMd: Pradhan Mantri Kaushal Vikas Yojana — Short Term Training (PMKVY-STT), run by the Ministry of Skill Development & Entrepreneurship, gives **free short-term skill training** to school/college dropouts and unemployed youth aged 15–45 at PMKVY Training Centres, helping them become job-ready in a chosen trade.
benefitsMd:
- **Free short-term skill training** in an industry-relevant job role at an empanelled PMKVY Training Centre.
- A **government-recognised certification** on passing the assessment, which improves employability.
eligibilityMd:
Open to any candidate of **Indian nationality** who:
- Is aged **15 to 45 years**.
- Has an **Aadhaar card and an Aadhaar-linked bank account**.
- Meets any additional criteria for the specific job role set by the awarding body.
applicationMd:
**Step 1:** Find an empanelled **PMKVY Training Centre** near you (via the Skill India portal / Skill India helpline).
**Step 2:** Enrol in the job role you want, with your Aadhaar and Aadhaar-linked bank account details.
**Step 3:** Complete the training and pass the assessment to receive your certificate.
